title: Inbound email result (P4, POST /email/inbound)
description: What pushing an email to an agent did (CR-11): the stored message (direction inbound, on the agent's own inbound address) and how the agent's inbound assignment dispatched it. 201 for a new message, 200 (dispatch.mode null) for a push already delivered (same Message-ID or Idempotency-Key).

taskId.description: The Task the mail spawned or joined (task-spawn).

threaded.description: The mail joined an existing thread through In-Reply-To / References.
